AWPTCM-T33274.objective:
• The AT-EPSRv2-MIB (and related atr-MIB) is supported, with OIDs accessible via SNMP and returning values consistent with the device's EPSR configuration and operational state as shown in CLI.
  • EPSR domain priority is correctly exposed through the MIB and matches the configured priority and CLI output.
  • EPSR-SLP port flags (IsOnCommonSegment and HasControlOfPortBlocking for primary and secondary ports) are accurately reported via SNMP and align with device state.
  • EPSR master node and transit node traps are generated with the correct bindings, including trap type, domain name, from and to states, control VLAN ID, primary/secondary port indices, and port states.
  • MIB table entries (e.g. atEpsrv2VariablesTable) and individual EPSR variables function as expected and are consistent with show commands.
  • EPSR MIB support includes proper trap notifications and handles documented behaviors such as fromState returning "unknown" (6) in certain conditions.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary coverage from TestLink EPSR MIB family (AWP-3991, AWP-1498, AWP-10347, AWP-4009, AWP-4010, AWP-1310, AWP-25021 and related). ART coverage from 5704 (AT-EPSRv2 MIB) and 1334 (EPSR trap behavior).
Configure an EPSR domain with a specific priority and ports. Query the AT-EPSRv2-MIB (and atr-MIB) OIDs for domain priority and confirm values match the CLI show output.
Verify EPSR-SLP specific MIB variables (domain priority, primary/secondary IsOnCommonSegment and HasControlOfPortBlocking flags) via SNMP and confirm they reflect the current EPSR state as per CLI.

Configure SNMP trap host and EPSR traps. Induce EPSR state changes to trigger master and transit node scenarios. Capture traps and verify all bindings (trap type, domain name, from/to states, control VLAN, primary/secondary port and state) match expectations.
Query the atEpsrv2VariablesTable and key EPSR MIB objects. Confirm the table and variables are populated correctly and consistent with device EPSR status.
Test MIB access in different EPSR roles (master, transit) and states. Confirm values update correctly and traps are sent with appropriate state transitions.
Verify that documented MIB behaviors are observed (e.g. epsrv2FromState may report "unknown" (6) in some cases) and that overall MIB support aligns with TestLink expectations.
